searchText: Hey is there a specific reason why asserts in the deposit contract don't have error messages? https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/blob/dev/deposit_contract/contracts/validator_registration.v.py <@415109946682769408> Do you know? <@387303511626350593> good point! I think we can add them after the audit. /cc <@550420431744794624> for the audit timeline Heads up -- I'll be off and AFK most of next week.
